description: Sidereal graha longitudes against Drik Panchang for a real chart. Pins the mean-vs-true node choice for Rahu/Ketu.

source.reference: Published longitude for the 1945-12-28 11:30 Kathmandu chart; carried forward from tests/test_kundali_detail.py::test_rahu_ketu_use_mean_node_matching_drikpanchang.
source.verified_by: Established while reverting payload-version 8: the mean node lands within the usual ayanamsha-formula tolerance (Drik 6d34'04" Mithuna, engine 6d34'29"), while the true node was off by 16.7 arcminutes (6d50'48").
source.notes: The single most load-bearing external check in the repository - it decided the mean-vs-true node question, which moves rashi and nakshatra near boundaries.

tolerance.rationale: Independent implementations of the Lahiri ayanamsha differ by tens of arcseconds; the engine notes a ~40 arcsecond spread against Drik across every graha. 60 arcsec accepts that formula difference while still rejecting the 16.7 arcminute (1002 arcsec) true-node error this dataset exists to catch.

entries.note: Mithuna starts at 60 deg; 6d34'04" = 6.56778 deg, so absolute longitude 66.56778 deg.
